problem: Decide how long to keep application logs that contain customer IP addresses
context: Logs are used for debugging and incident investigation. Storage cost is not a concern.

options.summary: Keep logs for 30 days, then delete them
Keep logs for 1 year, then delete them
Keep logs indefinitely in cold storage

criteria.description: Logs are available when investigations need them
Meets legal and privacy obligations for personal data

expected.why: The answer depends on legal obligations and investigation needs the decision doesn't state.
